blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Artificial general intelligence (AGI) requires a method that can understand, generate, reason, and act across diverse domains and modalities. Rather than relying on a single model to master every capability, a promising path toward AGI now is to orchestrate a heterogeneous ecosystem of specialized models, tools, and policies (candidates) into a unified AI system. At the heart of this vision lies a fundamental question: how can an AI system dynamically select and coordinate the most capable candidate for each task while balancing performance and computational cost? In this work, we present Route Anything, a unified framework for studying model and policy routing across general-purpose AI systems. We develop a unified theoretical foundation that characterizes optimal routing under quality--cost trade-offs and establishes how the information available to a router determines its attainable performance. To systematically investigate routing across diverse capabilities, we first construct an omni-modal trajectory matrix spanning 25 benchmarks across language understanding, image, video, and speech generation, coding and workplace agents, and robotic manipulation, comprising 374,401 scored runs from 452 candidate configurations. Building on this framework, we train and test different routers to investigate the potential of omni-modal model routing, the capabilities of learned routers, and the conditions under which routing improves efficiency. Our results reveal substantial opportunities for capability orchestration: per-input oracle routing outperforms the best fixed candidate by 5.4 points, and learned routers outperform it by 0.3 points across 16 benchmarks, by 2.1 points on video generation, and by 1.1 points on robot manipulation while using 24% less policy time. More importantly, routing raises efficiency by 8.82x on average compared with the reference model.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Agentic AI systems now can draw on multiple kinds of specialized models, tools, and policies: a language model answers a question, an image or video generator renders a prompt, a speech model reads text aloud, and a learned policy controls a robot. Rather than relying on one model to master every capability, a general-purpose system can orchestrate this heterogeneous ecosystem and choose, for each input, which module handles it. We call each such model, tool, or policy a candidate . The best candidate changes from input to input, so a router that chooses well is expected to match one fixed strongest candidate at a fraction of its price, or beat it by sending every input to the most suitable candidate that handles it best.
blocks.zh: 代理AI系统现在可以借鉴多种类型的专业模型,工具,和政策:语言模型回答一个问题,图像或视频生成器使一个即时,语音模型大声读取文本,学习到的政策控制一个机器人. 一个通用系统不能依靠一个模型来掌握每一种能力,而是可以协调这种多样化的生态系统,为每一种输入选择哪个模块来处理它。 我们称每个这样的模式、工具或政策都是候选人。 最佳候选者从输入到输入的改变,因此一个选择好的路由器预计将以自己价格的一小部分匹配出一个固定最强的候选人,或者通过将所有输入发送到最合适的处理它的最佳候选人来击败它.

blocks.en: Routing research has mostly studied language models: cascades that escalate to a stronger model [ 1 ] , routers learned from preferences [ 2 ] , and quality–cost formulations that connect the two [ 3 ] . Whether routing helps across modalities remains an open question. Thus we present a unified framework Route Anything for studying model and policy routing across modalities. To support such anlyasitical framework, we first build an omni-modal trajectory matrix in which every candidate in a pool runs on the same inputs, for 25 benchmarks across text and image understanding, image, video, and speech generation, code and workplace agents, and robot manipulation, with three to seven candidates per pool and 374,401 scored runs of 452 candidate configurations (Figure 1 ). We train and test routers using different strategies and ask three questions: how much can routing gain, how well do learned routers work, and when is a cheaper route good enough?
blocks.zh: Routing研究大多研究了语言模型:升级为更强模型的级联[1],路由器从偏好[2]学来,以及连接两者[3]的质量-成本配方. 途径是否有助于跨模式,仍然是一个有待解决的问题。 因此,我们提出一个统一的 " 万事通 " 框架,用于研究模式和政策跨模式的路径。 为了支持这种快速框架,我们首先建立了一个全方位模式的轨迹矩阵,其中,一个人才库中的每一名候选人都使用同样的投入,用于25项基准,这些基准跨越文字和图像理解、图像、视频和语音生成、代码和工作场所代理以及机器人操纵,每个人才库有3至7名候选人,以及374 401次得分的452次候选人配置(图1)。 我们使用不同的策略来训练和测试路由器,并问出三个问题:路由能获得多少收益,学到的路由器能发挥多大作用,什么时候更便宜的路由足够好?

blocks.en: Our unified routing theory frames all three: a router’s value is the best expected outcome, net of priced cost, given what it observes, so what it can reach is a ladder from the best fixed candidate to the per-input oracle, and a reference policy with a quality tolerance fixes the price of quality. The matrix measures each rung, and two code and text testbeds with recorded prices [ 4 , 5 ] add the cost side. We also provide empirical insights through extensive experiments:
blocks.zh: 我们的统一路由理论将这三者都设定为:一个路由器的价值是最佳的预期结果,从价格成本中扣除,考虑到它所观察到的情况,所以它所能达到的是从最佳固定候选人到每个输入指标的阶梯,以及一个具有质量耐受性的参考政策来决定质量的价格。 矩阵对每跑道进行测量,加上两个有记录价格的代码和文本测试床[4,5],加上成本一面. 我们还通过广泛的实验提供经验性见解:

blocks.en: Key findings 1. The potential gain for router is large (§ 3 ). On 19,814 test inputs from 24 benchmarks, the per-input oracle beats the best fixed candidate per benchmark by 5.4 points, from 0.7 for speech generation to 18–19 for video generation and robot manipulation. The best candidate per capability type, even chosen in hindsight, closes only 8% of the gap. 2. Learned routers beat the best fixed candidate by 0.3 points, and by up to 2.1 points per output group (§ 4.1 ). One capability-tree router over 16 benchmarks scores 79.98 against 79.68 for the fixed candidate and 84.80 for the oracle. Its gains come from agents, video, and image generation; none of 124 router configurations on GenEval2 and Qwen-Image-Bench beats the fixed generator significantly. 3. On robots, the router can also read the scene and saves time (§ 4.2 ). From three camera frames it sends clean scenes to PatchWAM and randomized ones to ME-Dex, matching the better policy in each condition: 71.6% success against 70.5% for the best single policy, with 24% less policy time. 4. Learn outcomes, not winners (§ 4.3 ). With the same inputs and backbone, regressing each policy’s success reaches 71.6% robot success and classifying the winner 42.8%, because a latency tie-break decides 94% of the winner labels. Winner-label routers on 16 benchmarks and a 68-type classifier also stay below the fixed candidate. 5. Compare candidates on the same inputs (§ 4.4 ). A fixed baseline that required a score on every training input dropped Opus 5.5, which missed 11 of 1,122 HLE scores, and turned a learned router’s 0.4-point deficit into a 2.4-point gain. 6. A cheaper route is often good enough (§ 5.1 ). Against the reference, routing raises efficiency by 8.82 × 8.82\times on average over four testbeds, including 25.5 × 25.5\times on code and 7.1 × 7.1\times on text QA. On CodeRouterBench the router fitted for zero quality loss never calls the Opus reference; the certified zero-loss floor holds on test in all 200 splits at a median 19.4 × 19.4\times , the fitted one in 12.5%. In image generation, a price route cuts cost by 26% within half a point. 7. Richer candidates and finer states are worth their cost only if they beat what they replace (§ 5.2 ). On CodeRouterBench, a failure roughly halves the next model’s success; a free compiler gate gives 4.09 × 4.09\times dollar efficiency, a list-price LLM judge 0.30 × 0.30\times .
blocks.zh: 主要调查结果 1. 路由器的潜在收益是巨大的(第3节)。 在来自24个基准的19 814个测试投入中,每输入甲骨文将每个基准的最佳固定候选人比5.4分,从语音生成的0.7分到视频生成和机器人操纵的18–19分. 每个能力类型的最佳候选者,即使是在后视选中的,也只能缩小8%的差距. 2. 学习路由器以0.3分击败最优秀的固定候选人,每个产出组最多以2.1分击败(第4.1节)。 一个能力树路由器超过16个基准,对固定候选人的成绩为79.98分,对甲骨文的成绩为84.80分。 其收益来自代理,视频,和图像生成;GenEval2和Quen-Image-Bench上的124个路由器配置都没有显著地击败了固定生成器. 3. 在机器人上,路由器也可以读取场景并节省时间(§4.2. 从三个相机框中,它向PatchWAM发送了干净的场景,向ME-Dex发送了随机的场景,在每个条件中匹配了更好的政策:71.6%的成功率和70.5%的最佳单一政策,减少24%的政策时间. 4. 学习成果,而不是赢家(第4.3节)。 凭借同样的投入和骨干,每个政策成功率的回落达到71.6%的机器人成功率,并将42.8%的获胜者归为一类,因为94%的获胜者标签由暂时解围决定。 16个基准上的胜者-标签路由器和一个68型分级器也保持在固定候选人以下. 5. 对候选人进行相同投入的比较(第4.4节)。 要求每一次培训投入得分的固定基线降低了Opus 5.5, 错过了11分的1 122 HLE 分数, 将一个学习过路由器0.4分的赤字变成了2.4分的得分. 6. 更廉价的路线往往足够好(第5.1节)。 反之,路由效率在4个试验台上平均提高了8.82×8.82分,包括编码上的25.5×25.5分,文本QA上的7.1×7.1分. 在Code Router Bench上,为零质量损失而安装的路由器从未使用过Opus参考;经过认证的零损失底片在所有200个分片中都按中位数19.4×19.4\时间进行测试,安装在12.5%中。 在图像生成中,价格路线在半分之内削减了26%的成本. 7. 较富有的候选人和较精细的州,只有打败了他们所取代的东西,才值得付出代价(第5.2节)。 在 Code Router Bench 上,一个失败大约是下一个模型成功的一半;一个免费编译器门赋予4.09× 4.09\times美元效率,一个列表价格的LLM评分0.30×0.30\tims.

blocks.en: (1) A unified theory of routing. We connect resource prices and quality constraints to optimal model and policy selection, and characterize how the information available to a router determines its attainable performance (§ 2 ). (2) An omni-modal trajectory matrix. We run 452 candidate configurations on the same inputs of 25 benchmarks across text and image understanding, image, video, and speech generation, code and workplace agents, and robot manipulation, for 374,401 scored runs (§ 3 and Appendix B ). (3) The potential of omni-modal routing. We quantify the potential gain of routing (5.4 points over the best fixed candidate), train and test learned routers that beat the best fixed candidate by 0.3 points overall and 2.1 points on video generation, show that task-type labels capture 8% of the potential gain on benchmarks with such labels, and examine how training targets and baseline choices affect measured gains (§ 3 and § 4 ). (4) When routing improves efficiency. We show that routing raises efficiency over the reference by 8.82 × 8.82\times on average and up to 25.5 × 25.5\times on code with matched quality, and evaluate on diverse conditions (§ 5 ).

blocks.en: Every candidate in a pool runs on the same inputs, and each run is scored by the benchmark’s own metric, rescaled to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] and reported on a 0–100 scale. The 25 benchmarks fall into seven groups (Table 1 ): text QA [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 ] , image-text QA [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] , image generation [ 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] , video generation [ 25 ] , speech generation [ 26 ] , code and workplace agents [ 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 , 31 ] , and robot manipulation [ 32 ] ; Appendix B lists them with their metrics and candidates. The language-model candidates are Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, joined by GPT-6 Astra on long-context, knowledge, and agent tasks. Inputs are split 70/10/20 into training, development, and test sets by source group, so identical inputs and items from one source never cross splits; RoboTwin’s 2,000 test scenes come from 10 tasks the routers never see in training. The fixed candidate plays the best candidate per benchmark on training inputs, where missing outcomes never disqualify a candidate (Section 4.4 shows why this matters), and the oracle plays the best observed candidate on each input. These are the outer rungs of Proposition 3 . We measure them on the 19,814 test inputs on which every candidate is scored, which leaves out SciCode, whose later steps contain each model’s own earlier code, and estimate the rungs in between with the best lookup per benchmark or per type chosen in hindsight.

blocks.en: On the 19,814 test inputs, the best fixed candidate per benchmark scores 82.60 and the per-input oracle 87.98 (Table 1 ). The gap is 0.7 points for speech generation, where every generator is nearly perfect, and 18–19 points for video generation and robot manipulation, where no candidate dominates. Little of it is available to a router that sees only the benchmark or the task type. The best candidate per benchmark chosen in hindsight raises 82.60 only to 82.62. On the 18 benchmarks of the rule-based capability tree, which assigns each of 5,034 test inputs to one of 107 capability leaves (Section 4.1 ), the best candidate per leaf chosen in hindsight scores 77.89, against 77.03 for the fixed candidate and 87.44 for the oracle: 8% of the gap lies between types. On RoboTwin, the best policy per task and scene condition, again chosen on the test scenes, recovers 23% of the 18.4-point gap. Code tasks show the same split. The best released CodeRouterBench routers capture 55% of the value of perfect routing information when the task type is unknown, but only 6–8% within a task type (Appendix C.5 ).

blocks.en: Our routers fine-tune Qwen3.5-4B on the task text and the output requirement, and for robots also on three camera frames and the robot state (Appendix B.3 ). An outcome router scores each pair of input and candidate profile with a sigmoid head, trained by cross-entropy against the candidate’s normalized outcome (Proposition 4 (a)), and plays the highest score. A type router classifies the input into a capability type and plays that type’s best candidate, read from a table fitted on training inputs, or the fixed candidate when it cannot place the input. A winner-label router is trained to name the best candidate. Each study is scored on the test inputs where all its compared policies have outcomes (Table 2 ); differences carry paired 95% bootstrap intervals over source groups, or over scenes for RoboTwin.

blocks.en: With the same inputs, backbone, and training scenes, the winner-label classifier reaches 42.8% robot success against 71.6% for per-policy outcome regression (Table 4 ). The labels explain the gap, as Proposition 4 (b) predicts: several policies succeed on most training scenes, a latency tie-break decides 94% of the labels, and 24,556 of the 31,408 successful training outcomes become wrong-class targets, so the classifier learns to pick fast policies (1.9 seconds per scene) that often fail. Outside robotics, no panel compares the two targets directly, and no target beats the fixed candidate. Generative winner-label routers on 16 benchmarks learn from 11,273 labels of which only a third are decided by a unique best outcome, the rest by cost, tokens, or a fixed order; the best of 12 recipes scores 78.87 against 79.44 for the fixed candidate. On 11 text, agent, and image benchmarks, the outcome router stays within noise of the matched fixed candidate ( − 0.40 -0.40 ), and a type router over 68 types, although 75% accurate, maps 93% of its predictions to the same candidate as the true type and scores 1.32 points below it.

blocks.en: A fixed baseline that admits a model only if it has a score on every training input drops strong models over a few missing scores. In the 11-benchmark study, Opus 5.5 missed a few scores on seven benchmarks, for example 11 of 1,122 training inputs of HLE, so the baseline fell back to the next model there: on HLE it scored 52.90 instead of 58.24, and on AA-Omniscience 70.00 instead of 77.50. Pooled, the baseline dropped from 68.30 to 65.52, and the outcome router’s 0.40-point deficit became a 2.38-point gain (Table 4 ). Choosing and evaluating the fixed candidate under the routers’ fallback, which uses GPT-6 Astra’s outcome where Opus 5.5 has none, removes the artifact. The same rule governs portfolios. Adding a model changes which tasks reach the fallback, so averages frozen at the current portfolio misrank candidates, whereas comparing both portfolios on the same tasks picks the best added model in 96.4–97.1% of CodeRouterBench comparisons, against 86.3–94.3% for frozen averages (Appendix C.3 ).

blocks.en: 5.2 Spending More Within a Task
blocks.zh: 5.2 在任务范围内花费更多

blocks.en: A candidate can spend more inside a task: a plan that retries after a failure, or that verifies an output and escalates on rejection. A router can also buy a finer state: a forecast of a candidate’s success, or a record of past outcomes. By Theorem 2 , a richer candidate is worth playing only if its value net of its full cost beats the candidates it replaces, and that value must be computed on the inputs that reach each step (Proposition 8 ). By Proposition 3 , a finer state can only help an optimal router, but it is worth buying only if the help exceeds its price (Proposition 9 ). We test both on CodeRouterBench, with fresh model calls for verifier verdicts and forecasts, and semi-synthetic streams for memory (Appendix C ).

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: Cascades and routers trade quality against cost [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] , and learned routers estimate each model’s quality from the query [ 34 , 35 , 36 , 37 , 38 ] . The acceptance step of a cascade is a reject option [ 39 ] , studied as confidence-based or budgeted deferral [ 40 , 41 , 42 , 43 , 44 ] . Dekoninck et al. [3] characterize optimal routing and cascading through a Lagrangian price tuned to a budget; here, the reference and the quality tolerance fix that price, and a finite-sample test certifies the resulting floor. Routing benchmarks record per-model outcomes and costs on shared prompts [ 5 , 4 ] .
blocks.zh: Cascades和路由器以成本交换质量[1,2,3],所学路由器从查询中估计出每个车型的质量[34,35,36,37,38]. 级联的接受步骤是一种拒绝选项[39],作为基于信任或预算的推迟[40、41、42、43、44]加以研究。 德克宁克等编. [3] 以拉格朗日价格调整为预算的最佳路径和连结特征;此处,参考和质量耐受性可确定价格,有限抽样测试可证明由此产生的下限。 运行基准记录每个模型的结果和共享提示的费用[5、4]。

blocks.en: SCOPE-Router arranges vision-language models for execution-oriented tasks [ 19 ] , and routing ideas also inspire vision-token pruning strategies [ 45 ] , dynamic submodels for video segmentation [ 46 ] , and acceleration policies inside diffusion transformers [ 47 ] . Coordinators, harness-level routers, and token-level routers extend routing beyond model identity [ 48 , 49 , 50 , 51 , 52 ] . We study routing across output types on one matrix: language models, image, video, and speech generators, and robot policies, all scored on shared inputs.
blocks.zh: SCOPE-Router为面向执行的任务安排了视觉语言模型[19],而路由思想也激发了视觉所接通的穿行策略[45],视频分解的动态子模型[46],以及传播变压器内部的加速政策[47]. 协调员、吊接级路由器和信使级路由器将路由扩展到模型身份之外[48、49、50、51、52]。 我们在一个矩阵上研究不同产出类型的路由:语言模型、图像、视频和语音生成器,以及机器人政策,它们都在共享投入上得分。

blocks.en: Algorithm portfolios choose among complementary solvers per instance [ 53 , 54 , 55 ] . Their virtual best solver corresponds to our per-input oracle, and its advantage over the single best solver gives the potential gain in Proposition 3 . Residual coverage measures what an additional solver contributes to the portfolio [ 56 , 57 ] . Accounting for call costs connects this selection problem to fractional programming, which optimizes ratio objectives such as quality per unit cost [ 6 , 58 ] . The value of information addresses the related question of whether acquiring a routing signal is worth its cost [ 59 , 60 ] . Similar cost considerations arise in test-time compute, where gains from extra calls depend on the task and allocation [ 61 , 62 ] , while imperfect verifiers can limit the gains from resampling [ 63 ] . Feedback-driven self-repair uses earlier attempts to guide later ones [ 64 , 65 ] , making resampling at equal cost a natural baseline [ 66 ] .
blocks.zh: 算法组合在每个实例中选择互补的解决者[53,54,55]. 他们的虚拟最佳解析器与我们的纯输入甲骨文相对应,它比单一最佳解析器的优势在Proposition 3中提供了潜在的收益. 剩余覆盖面衡量额外解决方案对投资组合的贡献[56、57]。 调用成本的核算将这一选择问题与分数编程相联,优化了单位成本质量等比例目标[6,58]. 信息的价值涉及获取路由信号是否值得其成本的相关问题[59,60]. 在测试时间计算中也出现类似的成本考虑,额外调用的收益取决于任务和分配[61,62],而不完善的核查者可以限制从再复制[63]获得的收益. 由反馈驱动的自修采用较早的尝试来引导后一种尝试[64,65],使以等价再生成为自然基线[66].

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
Across text, images, video, speech, code, and robots, the best candidate changes from input to input, and the per-input oracle sits 5.4 points above the best fixed candidate per benchmark. Most of that potential gain lies within task types, and a learned type router already scores 0.3 points above the best fixed candidate across 16 benchmarks, and up to 2.1 points within an output group.
In embodied scenarios, a router trained on camera frames tracks the best VLA policy in each scene condition and beats the best single policy by 1.1 points with 24% less policy time. Routing’s most reliable gain is a cheaper route that is good enough, raising efficiency over the reference by 8.82 × 8.82\times on average: when candidates are close in quality and far apart in cost, the reference and the quality tolerance fix the price, and a finite-sample test certifies the quality floor. Three rules follow: (1) compare candidates on the same inputs, and measure gains against the matched best fixed candidate; (2) train routers on per-candidate outcomes, and look for gains within task types; (3) fix the reference and the tolerance before ranking routes, and certify the floor on independent inputs.
blocks.zh:
在整个文本,图像,视频,语音,代码,以及机器人中,最佳候选人从输入到输入的改变,每输入甲骨文比每个基准的最佳固定候选人高出5.4分. 这种潜在收益大多在任务类型中,一个学习过的路由器在16个基准中已经比最佳固定候选人高0.3分,在一个产出组中最高可达2.1分。
在包含的情景中,一个经过相机帧培训的路由器跟踪每个场景条件中最好的VLA政策,并用减少24%政策时间的1.1分击败了最好的单一政策. Routing最可靠的收益是一条价格更低廉的路线,它足够好,平均比参考效率提高了8.82×8.82分:当候选人在质量上接近且成本上相去相去甚远时,参考和质量耐受性会决定价格,一个有限的抽样测试可以证明质量底线。 3个规则如下:(1)根据相同的投入对候选人进行比较,并对照匹配的最佳固定候选人衡量所得;(2)根据每个候选人的结果对路由器进行培训,并寻找任务类型内的所得;(3)在排名路线之前确定参考和容忍度,并在独立投入上认证底价.

blocks.en: The 25 benchmarks form seven groups: • text QA : MMLU-Pro [ 10 ] , MMLU-Redux [ 11 ] , SuperGPQA [ 12 ] , GPQA [ 13 ] , AA-LCR [ 14 ] , AA-Omniscience [ 15 ] , and the text subset of HLE [ 16 ] ; • image-text QA : MMMU-Pro [ 17 ] , MMMU [ 18 ] , and VLM-ExecRouterBench [ 19 ] ; • image generation : GenEval2 [ 20 ] , Qwen-Image-Bench [ 21 ] , LongT2I [ 22 ] , OneIG [ 23 ] , and WISE [ 24 ] ; • video generation : VBench-2.0 [ 25 ] ; speech generation : Seed-TTS English and Chinese [ 26 ] ; • code and workplace agents : AA-Briefcase [ 14 ] , AutomationBench [ 27 ] , GDP.pdf [ 28 ] , GDPval [ 29 ] , SciCode [ 30 ] , and Terminal-Bench [ 31 ] ; • robot manipulation : RoboTwin 2.0 [ 32 ] , 50 bimanual tasks in clean and randomized scenes. The matrix holds 374,401 scored runs on 103,307 tasks from 452 candidate configurations, which differ in model, harness, and effort. Understanding benchmarks score a binary answer (AA-Omniscience uses plain accuracy). GenEval2 uses its official Soft-TIFA-GM score, Qwen-Image-Bench its official hierarchical total, LongT2I a learned alignment score, OneIG the mean of the sub-scores that apply to a single image, and WISE binary correctness. VBench-2.0 averages the dimensions that apply to each prompt, so it differs from the official total. Seed-TTS scores intelligibility as 1 − WER 1-\mathrm{WER} (English) or 1 − CER 1-\mathrm{CER} (Chinese), clipped to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . AA-Briefcase scores the fraction of passed checks, AutomationBench assertion credit, GDP.pdf whether every criterion passes, GDPval the rubric fraction, SciCode step pass on the original tests, Terminal-Bench the official verifier reward, and RoboTwin 2.0 binary episode success. Agent candidates run in their native harness at maximum effort; understanding candidates answer in one zero-shot request at high effort.

blocks.en: The full set has 104,050 decisions over 25 benchmarks, split 70/10/20 with seed 42 by source group, so identical inputs and items from one source, such as the questions shared by MMMU-Pro and VLM-ExecRouterBench, never cross splits; existing research splits are kept, including RoboTwin’s split by task family (35 training, 5 development, and 10 test tasks). This gives 72,351 training, 10,630 development, and 21,069 test records; the router studies of Section 4 use the first release of 18 benchmarks (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 全套有104 050项决定,超过25项基准,将70/10/20和种子42按来源分组,因此来自一个来源的相同投入和物品,如MMMU-Pro和VLM-Exec-Router Bench共享的问题,从不交叉;保留现有的研究分裂,包括RoboTwin按任务家族划分(35项培训、5项开发和10项测试任务)。 这提供了72 351项培训,10 630项开发,以及2 069项测试记录;第4节的路由器研究使用了18项基准的第一次发布(表2)。

blocks.en: Fable 5.1, a retired model, is excluded from every evaluation; routers trained with it play Opus 5.5 in its place.
blocks.zh: 5.1号寓言,一种已退役的型号,被排除在每次评价之外;用它训练的路由器代替它演奏了Opus 5.5.

blocks.en: Leaves are defined per task and labeled on training inputs by GPT-6.1 Sol, which sees the input, the output requirement, and the leaf definitions, but no candidate outcomes. The classifier is Qwen3.5-4B with LoRA (rank 8), trained for three epochs on all 18 benchmarks at once with batch 16 and learning rates 10 − 4 10^{-4} (adapter) and 10 − 3 10^{-3} (head); the development split selects the epoch. The leaf table is fitted on training inputs by least squares over paired candidate differences on shared inputs.
blocks.zh: 叶片由GPT-6.1 Sol在培训投入上定义每个任务并标出标签,Sol看到输入,输出要求和叶片定义,但没有候选结果. 分类器为与LORA(第8名)相接的Quen3.5-4B,为三个时代培训了所有18个基准,同时有第16批和学习率10-4-10-4}(适应器)和10-3-10-Q-3}(头);开发分出选择了时代。 叶表用最小平方表示培训投入,而不是共用投入的对等候选人差异。

blocks.en: Both use Qwen3.5-4B with LoRA (rank 16, α = 32 \alpha=32 ) on every linear layer of the language model, a final-token linear head, AdamW with learning rates 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} (adapter) and 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} (head), 32 tasks per update, and six epochs, with seeds 42, 13, 2026, and 7. The outcome router reads one (input, candidate profile) pair per forward pass; its loss is the cross-entropy against the normalized outcome plus four times the squared error of within-task score differences. The type router predicts one of 68 capability types and reads a global type-to-candidate table fitted on training inputs.
blocks.zh: 两者在语言模型的每个线性地层上都使用与LORA(排名16,α=32\alpha=32)相接的Quen3.5-4B,一个最终接通的线性头,亚当W有学习速率2×10−5 2\times 10×5 (adapter)和3×10×4 3\times 10×4}(头),每次更新32个任务,以及6个有种子42,13,2026和7. 结果路由器每向前行传读取一对(输入,候选简介);其损失是相较于常态结果的交叉通向外加4倍于任务内分数差的平方误差. 类型路由器预测68个能力类型之一,并读取一个全球类型到指定表格,该表格被安装在培训投入上。

blocks.en: The outcome router uses Qwen3.5-4B with LoRA (rank 8), seven sigmoid heads, three epochs, batch 16, and learning rates 10 − 4 10^{-4} (adapter) and 10 − 3 10^{-3} (head); development routing success selects the epoch. The winner-label classifier shares the backbone, inputs, and data, with a seven-way softmax over the policy that succeeds, ties broken by measured inference time.
blocks.zh: 结果路由器使用Quen3.5-4B与Lora(排名8),7 sigmoid头,3个纪元,第16批,以及学习率10−4 10−4} (适应器)和10−3 10−3} (头); 发展路由成功选择了纪元. 赢家-标签分类器共享主干,输入,和数据,在政策上有一个七行软通,成功,关系被测量推断时间所打破.

blocks.en: Thirty-one router designs, among them RouterDC [ 35 ] , SCOPE [ 19 ] , IRT-based routers, k k NN, MLP, and two-tower scorers, and Qwen3.5 label routers with 0.8B to 9B parameters, are trained on GenEval2 or Qwen-Image-Bench prompts and tested on the same or the other benchmark: 124 configurations, with three seeds for stochastic methods. Each is compared with the fixed generator by a paired bootstrap over prompts.

blocks.en: CodeRouterBench [ 4 ] gives outcomes and token prices for eight models (claude-opus-4-6, claude-sonnet-4-6, gpt-5.4, Qwen3-Max, Kimi-K2.5, Qwen3.5-Plus, glm-5, and MiniMax-M2.7) on 9,999 coding tasks: 7,080 probing tasks (train and validation combined) and 2,919 test tasks. RouterBench [ 5 ] gives the 0-shot matrix of 36,497 prompts and eleven models. Dollar costs are token-price estimates; sequential seconds add recorded primary and fallback latencies. Policy, portfolio, retry, and signal studies replay recorded outcomes. Verifier verdicts and the LLM forecast are fresh calls through one OpenAI-compatible relay, with recorded Opus outcomes as the fallback; the memory study is semi-synthetic. Scores are on the benchmarks’ 0–1 scale, whereas the main text reports quality changes in points. Intervals are 95% percentile task-bootstrap intervals, paired for policy comparisons, and efficiency is a ratio of averages.

blocks.zh: C.6 路由器内存

blocks.en: This semi-synthetic study combines real outputs and verifier judgments with constructed arrivals and retention: 2,044 probing and 867 test tasks in 12 cells. With probability 0.25 the writer explores a uniformly sampled model, and it writes the model’s identity to the arriving cell when verification accepts; the newest record serves later tasks in that cell, and uncovered cells use the prior, always-Opus or the probing-fitted DimensionBest, which sends each dimension to its best model. Writers use ACRouter’s doctest and syntax tools, locally executed hidden tests, or a DeepSeek-v4-pro judge; we report hidden-test writes. A write is erroneous when the accepted output is incorrect under the released score; against that truth, hidden-test writes have TPR/FPR 0.960/0.205. Fifty streams of 60,000 rounds are measured over their last 10,000 rounds. With no expiration, the store reaches 135.8 score per dollar but scores 0.034 below always-Opus and 0.116 below DimensionBest.

blocks.en: The theory takes the law of states as given, so it does not cover states that depend on the router’s own earlier choices, such as SciCode steps that contain a model’s earlier code, and certification needs the reference’s outcome on every certification input. Moreover, step-level routing for long-horizon agentic tasks is more complex and deserves deeper exploration.
blocks.zh: 该理论以给定的状态定律为取向,因此它并不包括那些依赖于路由器自己早期选择的状态,例如包含模型早期代码的SciCode步骤,认证需要每个认证输入的参考结果. 此外,用于长距离代理任务的分级路径更为复杂并值得更深入地探索。
